question: Reconstruct Carneiro and Palhano Figure 2 IP-ranked comparison and Figure 3 correlations before any extension
selection: Unique exact nonempty GeneIDs; finite archived STAT_IP,LOG2_FC_IP,SE_IP; finite positive HL_WT and HL_CNOT3KO; finite stored HL_FC_LOG2. No adjusted-P filter. No subset search to match the published count.
rank_rule: Archived STAT_IP descending. Exact numeric ties ordered by exact GeneID ascending. A tie crossing the cutoff makes published membership ambiguous and holds the extension gate.
ratio_rule: Audit stored HL_FC_LOG2 versus log2(HL_CNOT3KO)-log2(HL_WT); retain stored values and all inconsistencies; never replace or exclude to improve agreement.
stat_rule: LOG2_FC_IP/SE_IP is a diagnostic only; zero or negative SE or inconsistency is a gate issue; never replace archived STAT_IP or select a different ranking.
effect_sizes: probability of high group exceeding remainder with half credit for ties
half_life_scale: Retain deposited numeric scale. A separate primary-figure audit authenticated printed labels in minutes; source-column calibration and fit semantics remain unverified. Do not compute absolute degradation rates in this reproduction.
ks_reference: Use existing scipy ks_2samp two-sided method=asymp if available. Conventional gene-distribution comparison only, not biological-replicate significance; ties/dependence can invalidate its calibration. No installation if unavailable.
spearman: Average exact-tie ranks and Pearson correlation of ranks, complete cases on HL_FC_LOG2,PTMD_SCORE,PTMD_SCORE_ABSOLUTE,STAT_IP within the fixed Figure2 reconstruction. Undefined for constant or fewer than two observations. No p-values.
PTMD_overlap: Top1000 PTMD_SCORE within the identical reconstructed Figure2 cohort only if every cohort row has finite PTMD_SCORE; otherwise not computed. This is explicitly a harmonized-universe diagnostic pending source-universe authentication; published279 is a comparison target, not a selection criterion.
unresolved_source_rules: The paper's >=10 reads in each of two input and two IP libraries cannot be independently rechecked from these processed columns.
Exact missingness exclusions and tie handling are not published.
The original top-PTMD overlap universe is not unequivocally stated; the reported chance expectation182 suggests a5481 universe but does not authenticate it.
Figure3 missing-data/correlation universe is not fully specified; the fixed complete-case reconstruction must be labeled accordingly.
Main gene-enrichment Methods describe DESeq2 while the supplementary figure caption describes Fisher's exact test.
Stored half-life units, per-guide/culture pairing, fit-quality/censoring/growth corrections and half-life uncertainty remain unauthenticated. SE_IP is not half-life uncertainty.
extension_gate: Always hold for root review of discrepancies and explicit source-rule limits. Count/ratio/ID/ranking discrepancies cannot be resolved by outcome-dependent subset search.
exposure: Published summaries already examined. Authorized reproduction will expose all selected cohort half-lives and aggregate results; later gene-heldout modeling must acknowledge this exposure. Noncandidate half-lives and L:X context features remain undecoded by the staged reader.
prohibited: reciprocal rate calculations with unauthenticated units
